newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Abiove soybean crush 2.01 mln tns in April.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Abiove soybean crush 2.01 mln tns in April.

text.p: Brazilian firms contributing to Brazilian Vegetable Oils Industries Association (Abiove) crushed 2.01 million tonnes of soybeans in April, up from 1.62 million in March, Abiove said.
Total crushings in the 1997/98 marketing year (February/January) were 4.48 million tonnes. Abiove estimates the data it receives represents between 90 and 92 percent of total Brazilian crushings.
As well as using domestic soybeans, Brazil imported a 228,000 tonnes between February and April, Abiove said.
The April figure left industry stocks at 6.82 million tonnes, up from 4.27 million tonnes at the end of March.
Crushings last year in April, when contributing companies represented 100 percent of the sector, reached 2.12 million tonnes, according to Abiove statistics.
Soybean stocks at the end of the month in 1996 were 6.50 million tonnes.
